name: RefSeq fish mitogenomes, COI and 16S regions
ncbi_query: Actinopteri[Organism] AND srcdb_refseq[PROP] AND biomol_genomic[PROP] AND mitochondrion[filter]
note: Each entry is the part of a fish's mitochondrial DNA between the two test markers (primers), cut out of the public RefSeq genome, with a little extra on each side. A fish with no RefSeq genome is simply not on this list.
